evidence.reason: update() now keeps already-`sent` outbox rows instead of resetting them to `pending` (so a repeated identical destination no longer re-sends a delivered completion or drops attempts/next_at), reports notify_status `sent` in that case while still re-arming `withdrawn`/`error` rows, and adds a test for the repeated-destination path.
